notes: Seating: a new tab on each class. Pick how the room is set up, drag students to desks, and Shuffle gives everyone a new seat. A student can be kept in their seat.
Pick a name shows one student at random, and nobody twice until everyone has had a turn. Make groups deals the class into groups of any size.
While presenting a lesson, P picks a name and G makes groups. Who’s here leaves out anyone who is away today.
